turns.question: Does Juniper drinking history mean she definitely has diabetes?
turns.answer:
Juniper's recorded history: Juniper's 2026-07-03 report: "Juniper was drinking more water during a hot week. I do not know whether the heat explains it." Juniper's 2026-08-02 report: "Juniper drinking seems back to usual this week. Her appetite is normal. No diagnosis of diabetes or another cause has been recorded here."
